claims.text: Crossformer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, Electricity at horizon 336.
Crossformer is best characterised as cross-dimension transformer with hierarchical encoder.

evidence.description: Reported MSE reduction of 15% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336.

limitations.text: Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested.
Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive.

future_work.text: Reducing memory usage at input length ≥ 2048 without accuracy loss.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
